messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "may need a lower dose or need to stop taking the medicine for a short period or for good"
set: ["may need a lower dose or need to stop taking the medicine for a short period or for good", "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "you may need a higher dose for a short time", "may need to temporarily stop taking", "may need to stop for short time if have surgery or medical emergency", "may need to stop for short time before planned surgery or dental procedure", "older adults may need lower dose", "doctor may tell to stop taking for short time", "may only need to take for a few days for acute pain", "may need to restart medicine at lower dose to avoid stomach problems", "dose may need adjusting", "need for arterial revascularization", "doctor may need to adjust dose accordingly", "may need to stop use before imaging tests", "drastically reduced need for sleep", "may need to stop use before surgery, medical procedure, or dental work"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time",
    "may need to temporarily stop taking",
    "may need to stop for short time if have surgery or medical emergency",
    "may need to stop for short time before planned surgery or dental procedure",
    "doctor may tell to stop taking for short time",
    "may need to stop use before surgery, medical procedure, or dental work"
  ],
  "alias": "may need to stop using the medicine for a short time"
}
